title: Domain Adaptation Based Pipeline for Character Classification and Handwritten Text Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.17952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Character classification and handwritten text recognition, particularly in specialized tasks, often suffer from limited labeled data, while a large amount of unlabeled data remains unused. To address this challenge, we propose a novel unsupervised domain adaptation-based pipeline to reduce the distribution gap between source and target domains. Our pipeline follows three main steps. In the first step, we pretrained an expert model on source data, to learn a strong general representation. In the second step, we perform unsupervised domain adaptation to leverage unlabeled target data, adapting the model to the specific characteristics of the target domain. In the third step, we trained the expert model on source data in the target style. By aligning the feature distributions between the source and target, our method enables the model to generalize effectively across diverse datasets. translated_title: 基于域适应的字符分类与手写文本识别流水线
translated_abstract: 字符分类和手写文本识别，特别是在专门化任务中，常常受到标注数据有限的困扰，而大量未标注数据仍然未被利用。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的基于无监督域适应的流水线，以缩小源域和目标域之间的分布差距。我们的流水线遵循三个主要步骤：第一步，我们在源数据上预训练一个专家模型，以学习强大的通用表示；第二步，我们执行无监督域适应，利用未标注的目标数据，使模型适应目标域的特定特征；第三步，我们在目标风格的源数据上训练专家模型。通过在源域和目标域之间对齐特征分布，我们的方法使模型能够在不同的数据集上有效泛化。无监督训练增加了计算时间……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于无监督域适应的三步流水线，通过对齐源域与目标域的特征分布并利用未标注目标数据，有效提升了标注数据有限情况下字符分类与手写文本识别的跨数据集泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel three-step unsupervised domain adaptation pipeline that aligns feature distributions between source and target domains and leverages unlabeled target data to improve cross-dataset generalization for character classification and handwritten text recognition with limited labeled data.
